sectionStyleRendering: server-side (section-metadata style -> section class; verified on /nav.plain.html)
bodyClasses: template + theme metadata (aem.js decorateTemplateAndTheme); locale-<cc> from the first path segment (scripts.js decorateLocale, '/' = locale-us)

chrome.nav: metadata nav, else /<cc>/<ll>/nav for non-us/en locale paths (falls back to /nav), else /nav
chrome.footer: metadata footer, else /<cc>/<ll>/footer (falls back to /footer), else /footer
chrome.delegate: metadata header-block / footer-block = name of a project block that renders the chrome instead (shipping-hub)
